description: This file defines functions and types related to loading and managing Claude bundle commands, including reading manifest files, parsing frontmatter, and discovering markdown command files within a plugin system.

methods.name: parseFrontmatterBool
methods.description: Parses a string value from frontmatter into a boolean, with a fallback default.

methods.name: stripFrontmatter
methods.description: Removes YAML frontmatter from markdown content, returning the main content.

methods.name: readClaudeBundleManifest
methods.description: Reads and parses the Claude bundle manifest JSON file from a given root directory.

methods.name: resolveClaudeCommandRootDirs
methods.description: Resolves command root directories based on the manifest and default 'commands' directory.

methods.name: listMarkdownFilesRecursive
methods.description: Recursively lists all markdown (.md) files within a directory.

methods.name: toDefaultCommandName
methods.description: Generates a default command name based on the file path relative to the root directory.

methods.name: toDefaultDescription
methods.description: Creates a description for a command, using the first line of the prompt template or the raw name.

methods.name: loadBundleCommandsFromRoot
methods.description: Loads command specifications from markdown files within a command root directory.

methods.name: loadEnabledClaudeBundleCommands
methods.description: Loads all enabled Claude bundle commands from the workspace directory, considering plugin activation states.
